description: Hardening PrepAura: fixing critical bugs, synchronizing API schemas, implementing real audio and speech telemetry, and establishing 4-vector scoring engine.

userStories.title: Fix Hugging Face URL syntax and missing HTTPException import in Backend
userStories.description: Resolve the malformed markdown link syntax inside the Hugging Face inference URL in ai_service.py and add the missing HTTPException import in interviews.py to prevent runtime crashes.
acceptanceCriteria: In Backend/app/services/ai_service.py, line 156 URL string literal contains no markdown formatting and reads: https://api-inference.huggingface.co/models/{settings.HF_MODEL_ID}
In Backend/app/api/routes/interviews.py, HTTPException is properly imported from fastapi
Python backend imports without errors: python -c "from app.main import app; print('OK')"
All backend tests pass via pytest

userStories.title: Implement Backend /api/dashboard endpoint
userStories.description: The frontend interviewService calls /dashboard, but the backend lacks this endpoint. Create an aggregated /api/dashboard endpoint providing user metrics, score trajectory, and recommended drills.
acceptanceCriteria: Backend/app/api/routes/analytics.py or a dedicated dashboard route defines GET /dashboard (mounted under /api)
Endpoint returns JSON matching frontend expectations: stats (interviewsCompleted, averageScore, questionsAnswered, currentStreak), scoreTrend array, skillAnalysis array, and recentInterviews array
Endpoint requires authentication via Depends(get_current_user)
Calling GET /api/dashboard with a valid token returns HTTP 200 with non-empty payload structure

userStories.title: Align Question Bank API routes and query parameters
userStories.description: questionService.js currently requests GET /questions, whereas the backend exposes GET /questions/bank. Align both frontend caller and backend router to prevent 404 errors.
acceptanceCriteria: Backend/app/api/routes/questions.py supports GET /questions/bank and optionally alias GET /questions
src/services/questionService.js requests the correct question bank route and passes topic/difficulty filters properly
Filtering by topic and difficulty returns matching Question items from database or fallback bank
QuestionBank.jsx renders filtered questions without console errors

userStories.title: Normalize interview result retrieval and frontend result debrief schema
userStories.description: Fix interview completion result routing (interview_id vs result_id) and normalize ResultResponse fields so InterviewResult.jsx renders without JavaScript TypeErrors when mock mode is off.
acceptanceCriteria: In src/pages/Interview.jsx, completing an interview navigates using the interview_id or ensures getInterviewResult can resolve either interview_id or result_id
Backend GET /api/interviews/{interview_id}/result returns a payload containing overall_score, competency breakdowns, strengths, weaknesses, and recommendations
src/services/interviewService.js or InterviewResult.jsx handles property normalization (e.g. overall_score vs overallScore, scores object, strengths, improvements, aiRecommendation) gracefully
InterviewResult.jsx renders cleanly without 'Cannot read properties of undefined' errors when live data is returned

userStories.title: Upgrade database model and evaluation engine to 4-vector scoring
userStories.description: Upgrade the Result model and evaluation engine to measure the 4 documented vectors: Technical Rigor (30%), Structured Delivery (25%), Problem Decomposition (25%), and Edge-Case Conviction (20%).
acceptanceCriteria: Backend/app/models/result.py defines technical_rigor_score, structured_delivery_score, problem_decomposition_score, and edge_case_conviction_score (or equivalent vector fields)
Backend/app/schemas/result.py exposes the 4 competency scores in ResultResponse
EvaluationService calculates overall_score using the weighted formula: (Rigor * 0.30) + (Structure * 0.25) + (Decomposition * 0.25) + (EdgeCases * 0.20)
All scores are constrained within the range [0, 100]

userStories.title: Implement real Web Audio API waveform telemetry in Interview chamber
userStories.description: Replace the static CSS animated bars in Interview.jsx with real microphone audio capture via Web Audio API AudioContext and AnalyserNode. Add live mic stream check in InterviewSetup.jsx.
acceptanceCriteria: In src/pages/InterviewSetup.jsx, clicking hardware test or mounting prompts for microphone permission and shows live audio input level
In src/pages/Interview.jsx, microphone stream connects to an AnalyserNode and updates waveform bars dynamically in real time
Graceful fallback waveform animation operates if microphone access is denied or unavailable (e.g. headless or non-HTTPS environment) without throwing console errors
Mute button properly suspends audio capture and updates UI indicator

userStories.title: Implement Web Speech API transcription in scratchpad
userStories.description: Connect speech recognition to the live scratchpad in Interview.jsx so candidate verbal answers are automatically transcribed into the text area in real time.
acceptanceCriteria: src/pages/Interview.jsx initializes webkitSpeechRecognition or SpeechRecognition if available in the browser
Spoken words append into the active answer scratchpad with continuous interim results
Manual typing in the scratchpad remains fully functional alongside voice transcription
If SpeechRecognition is unsupported in the browser, an informational status indicates manual typing mode without throwing unhandled exceptions

userStories.title: Implement session crash recovery in InterviewContext
userStories.description: Persist active interview session data, question index, elapsed timer, and draft scratchpad answers in localStorage so reloading or accidental navigation does not wipe candidate work.
acceptanceCriteria: src/context/InterviewContext.jsx writes session state changes to localStorage under a dedicated storage key
On page refresh on /interview/session, existing in-progress session restores seamlessly instead of kicking candidate back to /interview/setup
Completing or aborting the interview clears active session cache from localStorage
Reset and recovery mechanisms are covered by sanity test

userStories.title: Connect Analytics view to live backend overview endpoint
userStories.description: Create src/services/analyticsService.js and connect Analytics.jsx to fetch real metrics from GET /api/analytics/overview with fallback to mock data when backend is unreachable.
acceptanceCriteria: src/services/analyticsService.js created with getAnalyticsOverview method
src/pages/Analytics.jsx fetches data on mount via analyticsService
Render displays real user statistics, skill radar/bar chart, and recent score history
If backend is down, falls back cleanly to local mock metrics without throwing exceptions

userStories.title: Implement user profile persistence and settings storage
userStories.description: Enable Profile.jsx to persist candidate details via PUT /api/users/me and store chamber engine preferences and custom BYOK API keys in Settings.jsx in localStorage.
acceptanceCriteria: Profile.jsx commits changes to backend PUT /api/users/me when authenticated, updating local auth context
Settings.jsx stores model choice, strictness, voice, and BYOK API key in localStorage
On initial render, Settings.jsx reads saved preferences from localStorage
Zero emojis used in any status indicators, buttons, or toast notifications
